desc: Parse input: read N, K and the array A from stdin.
Build frequency array freq[v] for values up to M = max(A).
Compute cnt[d] = sum of freq over multiples of d (sieve loop, O(M log M)).
Compute best[x] = max divisor d of x with cnt[d] >= K via ascending slice-assignment over multiples.
For each A_i, output best[A_i] on its own line.
Implement the complete solution end-to-end with fast I/O and verify on samples plus edge cases (K=1, K=N, N=1).
